basis: Outer wall face pixels calibrated to dimension chains: x 246->0m,612->10m (10000mm south facade chain matches north facade chain, wall outer faces); y 880->0m(south wall),151->20m(north wall) using fine 20000mm chain on plan left/right margins matching West_view/East_view 20000mm facades. Interior wall/door pixel positions observed directly from plan cyan door arcs and gray wall lines. Vertical opening heights assumed from elevation drawings: exterior wall height 4500mm, windows sill 1000mm/head 3400mm, doors 0-2400mm (elevation chains showed 1100/2400/1000 for windows and ~1900/2400/200 for doors, consistent with these assumed heights).
